oracle_equivalence_determination.charter_clause_evaluated: Phase C Charter Section 'Allowed training information and oracle boundary' & Hypothesis H-C1
oracle_equivalence_determination.prohibition_tested: A task-side identifier cannot become a hard-coded correct routing map or an operation-specific Core/decoder solver.
oracle_equivalence_determination.extensional_vs_intensional_reduction: An intensional deterministic reduction algorithm R(x, D) -> z* is mathematically isomorphic to an extensional coordinate map table (x, k) -> z* for any fixed input x. Supplying a tie-break policy that selects the winning coordinate from degenerate candidates provides direct oracle coordinate determination rather than learning semantic routing from token supervision.

minimality_counterexamples.conclusion: Removing the oracle-equivalent TieBreakPolicy yields a lawful non-oracle descriptor, but this lawful descriptor CANNOT separate World A and World B. Indistinguishability under duplicate tokens holds.
Omitting arguments renders the extensional function f undefined even on clean inputs.
Omitting operation family destroys task identity.
